sentences.text: Luis y Marta iban a ir al parque con Sol.
sentences.english: Luis and Marta were going to go to the park with Sol.

sentences.text: Pero por la mañana empezó a llover.
sentences.english: But in the morning it started to rain.

sentences.text: —Qué lástima, ahora no podemos ir al parque —dijo Luis.
sentences.english: "What a pity, now we can't go to the park," said Luis.

sentences.text: Los niños tenían que quedarse en casa.
sentences.english: The children had to stay at home.

sentences.text: Miraba la lluvia por la ventana.
sentences.english: He watched the rain through the window.

sentences.text: Marta tomó un libro y empezó a leer.
sentences.english: Marta took a book and began to read.

sentences.text: Luis jugó con Sol en la sala y le dio una pelota.
sentences.english: Luis played with Sol in the living room and gave him a ball.

sentences.text: Después de una hora, Luis miró por la ventana.
sentences.english: After an hour, Luis looked out of the window.
"Look, it isn't raining any more!" he said.

sentences.text: Los niños y el perro salieron al parque.
sentences.english: The children and the dog went out to the park.

sentences.text: El suelo estaba mojado y Sol corrió por todas partes.
sentences.english: The ground was wet and Sol ran everywhere.

sentences.text: Después de todo, fue un buen día.
sentences.english: After all, it was a good day.
